help: clear the stage of what it no longer needs, as corpus-yoga cache clean clears the cache - every entry under tmp/stage that is neither the input, the scratch nor the rehearsal record, an orphan; every staged unit identical to the held one, a duplicate; and every unit whose record or payload is absent, incomplete. The scratch and the record are the rehearsal's to replace; a refused unit is evidence of another kind and stays
